name: Toronto Cleared Building Permits Open Data
known_limitations: The dataset covers permits that reached the cleared or closed state and has historical field and classification changes; it does not include every active permit or prove occupancy or project-wide completion.
automation_notes: Preserve permit and revision number, issue and closure fields, work type, address, data-vintage limits, and close-versus-occupancy boundary.
notes: Historical closed-permit rail for matched local conversion studies.
